rows.question: Who discovers information gap?
rows.owner: Field Perception Orchestrator information-gap detector
rows.gap: Needs route input and evidence feedback adapter.

rows.question: Who creates Observation Request?
rows.owner: Task Observation Request contract plus Field Perception Orchestrator request adapter
rows.gap: No single current A Route admission handoff.

rows.question: Who decides observation priority?
rows.owner: Attention candidate / Field Perception resource budget candidate; Safety policy may override
rows.gap: No runtime arbitration contract.

rows.question: Who decides spatial/semantic attention target?
rows.owner: Field Perception region planner and observation_manager attention coordinator
rows.gap: No bounded redirect loop.

rows.question: Who translates observation need to capability requirement?
rows.owner: Field Perception capability planner and model requirement adapter
rows.gap: Needs typed A Route integration.

rows.question: Who selects capability?
rows.owner: Capability Registry / Model Manager capability matcher
rows.gap: Availability/admission not closed to observation session.

rows.question: Who selects concrete model/provider?
rows.owner: Model Manager routing candidate and fallback planner
rows.gap: Selection is not invocation authority.

rows.question: Who allows provider start?
rows.owner: Capability/Model Admission plus Runtime Executor admission boundary; provider cannot self-start
rows.gap: No A Route runtime start admission and no product provider session.

rows.question: Who limits observation region/scope?
rows.owner: Field Perception region planner; downstream provider contract receives scoped request
rows.gap: Scope is not enforced at a unified execution boundary.

rows.question: Who limits execution budget/duration?
rows.owner: Field Perception resource budget candidate plus Model Manager resource evaluator; Self/Safety may constrain
rows.gap: No runtime lease or revocation handoff.

rows.question: Who judges evidence sufficiency?
rows.owner: No single canonical owner; Field Perception and observation_manager expose candidates only
rows.gap: Need task/information-need-relative sufficiency contract.

rows.question: Who decides additional OCR?
rows.owner: Field Perception capability planner / observation_manager OCR request candidate
rows.gap: Vision cannot autonomously launch OCR; missing governed follow-up admission.

rows.question: Who decides additional SLAM spatial evidence?
rows.owner: Field Perception capability planner / spatial capability and provider admission contracts
rows.gap: No task-relative spatial need gate.

rows.question: Who decides continue YOLO/detection?
rows.owner: Field Perception Orchestrator demand and re-observation policy
rows.gap: No runtime stop/continue lease; frame arrival cannot authorize continuation.

rows.question: Who decides provider switch?
rows.owner: Model Manager fallback planner, subject to admission and resource policy
rows.gap: No bounded switch decision linked to information need and evidence gap.

rows.question: Who decides redirect attention?
rows.owner: Attention candidate / Field Perception region planner / Cognitive Flow reconsideration
rows.gap: No single route-level redirect handoff.

rows.question: Who decides stop observation?
rows.owner: Field Perception stop condition candidate, bounded by A Route and runtime admission
rows.gap: No product stop/revocation execution path.

rows.question: Who handles provider failure?
rows.owner: Model Manager diagnostics/fallback candidates plus A Route orchestration error routing
rows.gap: No closed failure-to-new-demand loop.

rows.question: Who handles contradictory evidence?
rows.owner: Observation Gateway preserves contradiction; Cognitive Flow reconsideration and Field Perception gap logic consume it
rows.gap: Must trigger bounded reconsideration or confirmation, not provider fan-out.

rows.question: Who returns Observation Gateway output to cognitive cycle?
rows.owner: Observation Gateway -> A Route Orchestration -> Cognitive Flow
rows.gap: No active-demand feedback loop back to Field Perception control.
